definitions.explanation: A state of competing with others, especially in business contexts where companies vie for the same market or customers.

examples.japanese: {競合|きょうごう}⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注視|ちゅうし}している→注視：16389_chuushi⟧。
examples.english: We are closely watching the movements of our competitors.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{競合|きょうごう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many companies are competing in this market.

examples.japanese: {競合|きょうごう}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}して→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We set prices by comparing with competing products.

notes:
{競合|きょうごう} emphasizes direct competition where multiple parties target the same market, customer base, or resource. It is heavily used in business contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
{競|きょう} (compete) + ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (together) — competing against each other.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競合|きょうごう}⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧: competing companies, competitors
- {競合|きょうごう}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: competing products
- {競合|きょうごう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: competitive relationship
- {競合|きょうごう}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: competitive analysis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: broader term for competition in general (sports, academics, business). {競合|きょうごう} is more specific to head-to-head rivalry, especially between companies.
- ⟦{対抗|たいこう}→対抗：12398_taikou⟧: opposition, standing against. Implies actively countering a rival rather than simply being in the same market.
